Beijing Defends Cuba's Raul Castro Amid Florida Murder Warrant

Beijing has defended former Cuban leader Raul Castro following the issuance of a murder warrant against him in Florida. Cuban American lawmakers have welcomed the warrant and pledged continued efforts for Cuba's freedom. The specific details of the allegations leading to the warrant were not provided in the coverage.
